In every other permission mode the plugin stays silent, so hum"},{"id":"p4s5","text":"an approval is never front-run by the model."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"It is the dsh equivalent of Codex's `approvals_reviewer=auto_review` (`--approve-for-me`), and it fo"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"llows the review design of AGENTSCOPE-PLAN-058 / 062 / 063 (orthogonal reviewer dimension, three-way"},{"id":"p5s3","text":" decision, routing policy, prompt isolation, fail-to-human, circuit breaker)."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"> **Warning**: an AI reviewer is a policy choice, not a security guarantee. Prefer it for low-risk workflows; keep `hum"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"anOnlyList`, the `denyList`, and the circuit breaker tight."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Design"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"| Concept (this plugin) | Codex | AGENTSCOPE-PLAN-058 |"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"| A dedicated permission mode activates the reviewer | `approvals_reviewer: auto_review` + `--approv"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"e-for-me` | UI preset `帮我批准` = `DEFAULT` + `ApprovalReviewer=MODEL` |

ESCALATE and model failures never fabricate a rejection — they hand the request to the n"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"ext answerer (the human UI), and a deployment with no human answerer fails closed (`unavailable`), e"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"xactly like Codex's fail-closed guardian.
- **The mode gate makes the modes exclusive.** In the `帮我批"},{"id":"p12s5","text":"准` preset the reviewer answers; in `请求批准` (and every other preset) the plugin delegates, so human ap"},{"id":"p12s6","text":"proval behaves exactly as before. The two presets share sandbox/approval knobs; the recorded `permis"},{"id":"p12s7","text":"sion/preset` selection tells them apart.
- **One terminal answerer per deployment.** The dsh approva"},{"id":"p12s8","text":"l chain is not a priority list of competing judges — compose one answerer. To keep human override, p"},{"id":"p12s9","text":"ut a human UI answerer behind this plugin (the waterfall `next()` reaches it).
- **Arguments are rea"},{"id":"p12s10","text":"d from the session log**, not from the approval request (the request deliberately carries no argumen"},{"id":"p12s11","text":"ts to avoid a second rendering that could drift)."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Security model"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"- **Mode gating keeps human approval unchanged**: outside the configured preset the plugin delegates"},{"id":"p14s2","text":" every request, so `请求批准` behaves exactly as before the plugin existed.
- **Prompt isolation**: the "},{"id":"p14s3","text":"reviewer prompt is assembled by this plugin from its own config; the main agent never sees the secur"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"ity policy, so it cannot tailor asks to pass review. Tool descriptions come from the live registry ("},{"id":"p14s5","text":"`ctx.tools.schemas()`), arguments from the durable log — the reviewer judges the real call, not the "},{"id":"p14s6","text":"agent's claim.
- **Fail-to-human**: `TIMEOUT`, `PARSE_ERROR`, and provider errors produce ESCALATE ("},{"id":"p14s7","text":"delegate), never a fabricated denial, and are not counted in the circuit breaker (PLAN-058 §4.8 sepa"},{"id":"p14s8","text":"ration of model failure from policy decision).
- **Fail-closed by composition**: a deployment with n"},{"id":"p14s9","text":"o human answerer resolves `unavailable`, which callers treat as denial.

- **Sensitive data**: review input (too"},{"id":"p14s12","text":"l arguments, reason) is used only for the reviewer request and structured logs; it is not stored bey"},{"id":"p14s13","text":"ond the ordinary session log and console output. Turn `includeArgs` off if arguments are sensitive."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"- **No dedicated log-only audit event.** Model decisions are visible in the main chain as `user/mess"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"age` notices (durable and replayable), and the built-in `approval/asked` + `approval/decided` pair r"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"ecords the ask/outcome. A dedicated machine-readable audit event (like a `session/approval-llm-reque"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"st` with the full review context) is still blocked by the harness persistence policy for out-of-repo"},{"id":"p16s5","text":" event types; when the harness ships a registration surface, this plugin should add one.
- **No clie"},{"id":"p16s6","text":"nt-side badge (yet).** The decision notice appears as a transcript message; a Codex-style shield ico"},{"id":"p16s7","text":"n anchored to the tool card needs a client plugin (the package ships no browser half yet). See the r"},{"id":"p16s8","text":"oadmap below.
- **One request per model call.** PLAN-063's batch review (one call for several pendin"},{"id":"p16s9","text":"g tools) needs a batch entry point in the approval service; the dsh seam processes one request at a "},{"id":"p16s10","text":"time. Per-request latency is bounded by `timeoutMs` and the reviewer model choice.
